blocks.text: Juniper seed transfer procedure
Anika Rao prepared this procedure for the autumn archive handover. Accept only dry, labelled packets; quarantine any packet whose seal or moisture record is uncertain.
Intake checks

inlines.text: Record the packet mass before sealing
. Repeat the measurement if the scale was moved.
Apply the same mass rule after repacking
. The reused note defines one rule for both steps.
. Anika reviews the quarantine shelf each Friday.
The retention schedule is documented in the archive handbook

Internal training copy | Keep packets dry during every transfer
Mass rule: use the dry mass in grams, rounded to two decimal places; include the inner sleeve but exclude the outer label.
Quarantine rule: condensation includes visible droplets or a damp inner sleeve, even when the packet mass is acceptable.
Retention schedule: keep a signed handover record for 18 months after the transfer date.
